summary: New item `fx` (experimental, ADR 0022): the effects layer's CSS materials — glass with its edge, inner and specular modifiers, grain, sheen, glow, shimmer and ink — applied as a class on a component's ROOT through the typed fx() helper (`<Card className={fx("glass", "edge")}>`) and reaching the part they paint through data-slot, so no component gained a prop. One stylesheet per effect under styles/fx/, imported through fx.css after Tailwind and the theme; every rule sits in `@layer fx`, so an effect outranks a component's utilities while the app's unlayered CSS outranks the effect, and `revert-layer` hands every property back under reduced transparency, reduced motion and forced colours — the component is the floor. Background effects compose in one stack (base.css) on non-inheriting layer variables, keeping a part's own gradient (Slider's track fill, Progress's gradient variant). sweep(element) plays sheen's one-shot pass of light. EFFECTS is the single source of what exists and where it applies; check:fx and fx.browser.test.tsx hold the stylesheets to it. Install: add the item, then `@import "./fx/fx.css";` after the theme. Glass needs a theme carrying --ui-bg-glass (see the token entry of the same date).
